Q: Apache kafka not running on windows A:

Try this.

Open Kafka\bin\windows\kafka-run-class.bat with text editor/ notepad.

Search for rem Log4j settings in the file.

Change

    set KAFKA_LOG4J_OPTS=-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=file:%BASE_DIR%/config/tools-log4j2.yaml

to add an initial / before the path:

    set KAFKA_LOG4J_OPTS=-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=file:/%BASE_DIR%/config/tools-log4j2.yaml

I was facing the same issue and this solved the error for me.

Additionally if it doesn't solve your issue, you can print the property using

echo %KAFKA_LOG4J_OPTS%

to check what is the actual property value. Either add this after else block or run this on cmd after executing bat file.

Q: P4merge as Git Merge tool A:

The complete set of commands is:

git config --global merge.tool p4mergetool
git config --global mergetool.p4mergetool.cmd "p4merge \$BASE \$REMOTE \$LOCAL $MERGED"
git config --global mergetool.p4mergetool.trustExitCode false
git config --global mergetool.keepBackup false
git config --global diff.tool p4mergetool
git config --global difftool.p4mergetool.cmd "p4merge \$LOCAL \$REMOTE"
git config --global difftool.prompt false
git config --global mergetool.prompt false

This yields a ~/.gitconfig

[merge]
    tool = p4mergetool
[mergetool "p4mergetool"]
    cmd = p4merge $BASE $REMOTE $LOCAL $MERGED
    trustExitCode = false
[mergetool]
    keepBackup = false
    prompt = false
[diff]
    tool = p4mergetool
[difftool "p4mergetool"]
    cmd = p4merge $LOCAL $REMOTE
[difftool]
    prompt = false

For this to work, p4merge has to be in your $PATH (or %PATH% on windows), otherwise you need to specify the full path to the p4merge binary.
